issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> — bl(t.title, lang) returns a span inside a native <select><option>. Cosmetic (only DevTools warning) but should render plain text inside <option>. File: /app/frontend/src/components/CutEditor.jsx line ~126.

action_items: Optional cleanup: In CutEditor.jsx <option> for music tracks, render bilingual title as a string (e.g. lang==='es'? t.title.es : t.title.en) instead of a React element to remove the hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: CutEditor.jsx <option> child is a React element (bl() likely returns a <span>), producing a React hydration warning in DevTools. Not user-visible but should be a plain string.
CutEditor.jsx apply() uses timeout 300000ms but there's no visible progress feedback beyond the button spinner + label; consider a lightweight progress hint since renders can take 30-60s.

SocialImageEditor.jsx: overlay POST does not send updated_at/cache-busting header; UI relies on ?ts= in preview src. OK for now, but for defense, backend could set Cache-Control: no-store on the image endpoint.
